comment: frames[] index == world GID (0..20). Tweak sx,sy,sw,sh on a 128px grid; sheet is 1024x1024.

frames.comment: GIDEmpty — nothing drawn (transparent over clear color)
GIDGrass — green walkable ground
GIDWall — solid stone wall
GIDCracked — cracked brick wall
GIDDoor — staircase dungeon entrance
GIDWater — blue water
GIDLock — locked door iron gate
GIDFloor2 — alternate dungeon brick floor
GIDTree — forest pine tree
GIDWaterShoreTop — water with top grass shore
GIDWaterShoreBottom — water with bottom grass shore
GIDWaterShoreLeft — water with left grass shore
GIDWaterShoreRight — water with right grass shore
GIDWaterShoreNE — water with grass shore in North-East corner (convex)
GIDWaterShoreNW — water with grass shore in North-West corner (convex)
GIDWaterShoreSW — water with grass shore in South-West corner (convex)
GIDWaterShoreSE — water with grass shore in South-East corner (convex)
GIDWaterShoreNEInner — water with concave shore in North-East corner
GIDWaterShoreNWInner — water with concave shore in North-West corner
GIDWaterShoreSWInner — water with concave shore in South-West corner
GIDWaterShoreSEInner — water with concave shore in South-East corner
